name: week
title: Formulation desk: this week
subtitle: Internal working records. Technical review remains with the food business.

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,review_state,review_due from review_queue order by code

sections.title: Evidence to clear
sections.sql: select code,rule,problem from compliance_findings order by code,rule

sections.title: Recipe costs
sections.note: Ingredient costs only. Unknown costs are never treated as zero. No currency conversion.
sections.sql: select code,currency,input_g,yield_g,batch_cost_amount,serving_cost_amount,unknown_costs from recipe_costs order by code

sections.title: Specification renewals
sections.sql: select code,name,supplier,spec_review_due,recipes_using,recipe_codes from ingredient_usage order by spec_review_due nulls first,code
